product_metadata.title: BUILT Gourmet Getaway Soft Neoprene Lunch Tote Bag-Lightweight, Insulated and Reusable, Micro Dot

NEOPRENE INSULATING MATERIAL: Keeps food cold (or warm) for up to 4 hours, depending on the content and outside temperature; The cooler the contents the longer they will stay cold

description: The Gourmet Getaway Lunch Tote from BUILT makes it easy to go gourmet at school, work, or any time on-the-go. Made for environmentally conscious people who want to reduce waste and considered the gold standard among reusable insulated lunch totes. This mid-sized, stretchy neoprene lunch tote is made from durable, machine washable neoprene. No need to worry about accidents and spills inside or outside because you can easily machine wash it on cold and let it air dry. Also, it’s BPA-free, vinyl-free, PVC-free and tested for lead safety - tested for your safety in mind. The neoprene construction helps keeps food cold (or warm) for up to 4 hours, depending on the content and outside temperature; the cooler the contents the longer they will stay cold. Also, the neoprene material allows the lunch tote to expand to fit a variety of food and drink containers with a flat bottom to sit upright. This tote packs more than you would think but is still able to fold flat to take up less space and store easily. This lunch tote has a smooth secure zipper closure to keep your lunch inside when you are on the go. The soft grip neoprene handles make it easy to carry and the neoprene stretches for maximum comfort on your fingers. Available in a variety of fun colors and patterns.

Great for road trips, plane rides, or any time you're on the run and need provisions to keep you going. And unlike those brown bags, you'll want to reuse one of these insulated lunch bags over and over again. If you're a foodie who spends time in the culinary fast lane, then the Gourmet Getaway is for you.
